summary: Faz-3 Drift Action Center Testing Complete. All backend endpoints (24 tests) and frontend UI verified. Drift actions (Ack/Mute/Ignore/Disable Strategy/Retrain) working correctly with proper confirm phrase enforcement, mute duration validation (1h/24h/7d only), and response contract {status, trace_id, message, state_snapshot}.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend drift action response contract {status, trace_id, message, state_snapshot} properly implemented for all 5 drift actions
Mute duration validation correctly enforces only 1h/24h/168h (7d) - rejects 2h, 12h, 48h etc
Ignore action requires 'IGNORE DRIFT ALERT' confirm phrase - properly rejected without it
Disable Strategy action requires 'DISABLE VIA DRIFT' confirm phrase - properly rejected without it
Disable Strategy implements throttle->pause->disable chain (no hard disable) via linked_action_result
Retrain action returns retrain_status=queued and retrain_job_id starting with 'retrain_'
Deep-link structure includes target_tab (strategy_governance/rollout), strategy_id, and context_filter
Super admin authorization (require_super_admin) properly blocks ops users with 403 on all drift endpoints
Frontend Drift Action Center tab visible with all action buttons (Ack, Mute, Ignore, Disable Strategy, Retrain, Open Policy)
Frontend mute modal shows correct duration options: 1h, 24h, 7d
Frontend confirm input placeholders correctly show required phrases for Ignore and Disable Strategy

success_rate.frontend: 100% (All UI elements verified: drift alert cards, action buttons, modals with mute selector, confirm inputs, deep-link navigation)

seed_data_creation: None required - used existing drift alerts from pipeline
